analysis_plan.not_claimed: 40-iteration convergence, consistency or optimality of C_Q
analysis_plan.primary: per cell and checkpoint (10, 20, 40): number of datasets whose selected K equals K_TRUE = 9 (Clopper-Pearson 95% CI), under/over
secondary: transitions of selected K 10->20->40 per dataset
per-init selected K and init disagreement per checkpoint
gap C_Q_bar(9) - C_Q_bar(selected K) and G(t) = C_Q_bar(9) - min_{K!=9} C_Q_bar(K) for t = 1..40
per-K C_Q_bar improvement 10->20->40 and mean per-iteration improvement over the last 3 iterations before each checkpoint
numerical anomalies: failures, M-step strict-Q decreases, NaN
analysis_plan.unit: dataset (inits are not independent evidence; checkpoints of one dataset are not independent evidence)

criterion: C_Q = -2 Q_strict + p ln n (Q-based complete-data / ICL-type; NOT Schwarz BIC); its ln p(Z) term adds n(1+ln 2pi) per latent dimension
definition: new deterministic run with the frozen seeds; not a resume; C_Q(t) = calc_bic_exp(q_after[t]); gate: C_Q(10) == main C_Q bitwise
failure_rule: a failed fit is recorded once (failures.csv) and never replaced; a dataset with any missing/FAILED fit is INCOMPLETE at that checkpoint
no_adaptive_changes: no extra iterations, seeds, cells, checkpoints, init rules or criterion changes after results

researcher_decisions_20261125.D-A: lineage E results are a candidate for the thesis body; Human Gate NOT passed; not treated as adopted
researcher_decisions_20261125.D-B: run B-b-9, O-b-9, A-b-9 (600 fits) convergence sensitivity
researcher_decisions_20261125.D-C: C_Lap is a separate future exploratory analysis; not run here

resume_rule: a fit is done iff its fit_id has a row in per_fit.csv (any status); done fits are never re-run; FAILED fits are never retried or re-seeded; not-done fits are run with their frozen seeds; orphan history/checkpoint rows of not-done fits (crash between writes) are kept and must be bitwise identical to the re-run rows (checked by --analyze)
seeds: copied from the main manifest (no new seeds)
selection: per dataset and checkpoint: mean of C_Q over 2 inits, argmin, ties within 1e-9 -> smallest K (same as main)
status: EXPLORATORY (planned after the main results were seen)
stop_rules: any checkpoint-10 C_Q differs bitwise from the main per_fit C_Q
any regenerated X/Y hash differs from the main run
code hash mismatch / dirty tree / output exists without --resume
